server.description: SQL Server host name or address. A named instance is written host\instance.

port.description: TCP port. Leave empty for the default (1433) or a named instance.

database.description: Database to run the queries in.

password.description: Password for the SQL Server login. Vaulted; never stored in the config.

trustServerCertificate.description: Accept a server certificate that is not signed by a trusted CA (self-signed on-premises servers).

connectTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the connection to open.

commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for each query (0 = no limit). Applies per network read, so a streaming query is not cut off as a whole.

systemName.description: Override for the Identity Atlas system name. Defaults to the crawler's own name.

batchSize.description: Records per ingest call. Rows stream from SQL Server and are flushed every batch, so memory stays flat however large the result set.

pageSize.description: Value bound to @PageSize for a query that pages with @Offset / @PageSize.

watermarkOverlapSeconds.description: How far back of its last watermark each delta re-reads. Covers clock drift between the source's application servers and transactions that commit after rows with later timestamps. Re-read rows are upserts, so too large only costs time; too small loses rows silently.

sweepIntervalHours.description: How often a query with sweep enabled reads its complete key set to find what the source no longer has. A removal shows within one interval. 0 disables the sweep.

sweepMaxDeleteShare.description: The largest share of a scope a sweep may remove before it refuses and writes nothing. A source read mid-aggregation looks like a mass revocation, and a delete has no undo.

sweepOverride.description: Let a sweep remove any share of a scope, for the one run where a large removal is known to be real.

queries.description: The SQL statements to run, one per object type. Each statement's columns follow the column contract for its target (see docs/sync/sql.md).

name.description: Label shown in the job log.

target.description: Which Identity Atlas object type the rows become.

sql.description: A SELECT statement. Reference @Offset and @PageSize to have the crawler page through it; reference @Since (with watermarkColumn) to have it read only what changed.

watermarkColumn.description: The returned column whose largest value this run remembers, so the next run can bind @Since to it and read only rows that moved (e.g. modified). The statement must bind @Since. Leave empty to read in full every run — which is what lets the scope be reconciled without a key sweep.

sweep.description: assignments only: periodically read this statement's complete key set and remove the assignments the source no longer has. A watermark cannot find a removal, so a windowed assignments query needs this.

resourceType.description: resources / assignments: the resourceType every row gets (e.g. Entitlement, BusinessRole).

ownership.description: resources: turn the statement's ownerId column into a real owner you can click, instead of leaving it as an attribute. Adds three rows (an ownership resource, a link and the owner's assignment) per resource that has an owner.

systemType.description: systems: the systemType every system this statement creates gets when the row carries no systemType column of its own. Defaults to SQL.

assignmentType.description: assignments: how the principal holds the resource.

governed.description: assignments: the assignment is governed (a business-role membership).

principalType.description: identities / principals: default principalType when the row has no principalType column.

columnMap.description: Map a source column name to a contract column name (e.g. EntitlementID -> id) when your SELECT does not already alias it.

contextType.description: contexts: the contextType every row gets (e.g. Application). Required on a contexts query.
